The deepest reading was −1.48 on 10-20; since then it has baselined between −0.82 and −1.19. 1. **Regime:** Structural uptrend intact (price > 50 SMA > 200 SMA, both rising; MACD positive). Tactical momentum is paused (MACD histogram negative 10 sessions, RSI 53, price below the 20-day mean). The market is in a **bull-flag/digestion phase one month off its all-time high**, roughly 100% above its June capitulation low (106.37 on 6/25 → 212.94 intraday on 10/12).

The Q3 print is the decisive binary event: Oppenheimer explicitly forecasts a **revenue beat + guidance raise**. **Net stance: cautiously constructive into earnings, but event-risk-aware — the path of least resistance higher requires a beat-and-raise confirmation; the premium valuation leaves little room for a miss.**

**Bullish catalysts:**
- **JPMorgan initiated PLTR at Overweight with a $262 price target**, calling Palantir a "disruptive AI leader" — the highest-profile positive initiation among the bulge brackets this week, and a notable turn after a year of valuation skepticism.

**Read-through:** Sell-side is doing the bullish work while the tape refuses to confirm. This divergence typically resolves one of two ways: (a) earnings beat-and-raise → violent short-covering/momentum squeeze, or (b) any stumble → the premium multiple compresses hard with no valuation floor sentiment.

5. **Flow support exists but is shallow.** JEPQ's Oct 27 inclusion adds structural demand, but it's marginal — it cushions, it doesn't drive. The IGV software-ETF activity and the broad AI-automation theme keep PLTR in the "must-own AI software" conversation, sustaining liquidity and retail interest.
